newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: HL&H SEES YR LOSS DUE TO RAINBOW .
newsitem.headline: HL&H SEES YR LOSS DUE TO RAINBOW .

text.p: Hunt Leuchars & Hepburn Holdings Ltd (HL&H) on Thursday warned that it expected to post a loss for the full year ending March 31 due to subsidiary Rainbow Chicken Ltd's poor performance.
Narrowing its half year net loss to 11.73 million rand from 40.01 million rand, HL&H said in a statement that the blow dealt it by Rainbow would hold the group in the red for the year.
"The significant impact of Rainbow's performance on group results means that HL&H expects to report a loss for the full year," food group HL&H said.
Rainbow reported a 159.8 million rand net loss for the year ended March 31 compared to a 16.7 million rand profit in the previous year.
Due to HL&H's improved but still disappointing results -- it posted a 7.8 cent loss per share versus 26.7 cents loss previously -- the group did not declare an interim dividend.

HL&H said it had managed to restrict its attributable loss for the six month period ended September by means of the 30 million rand profit it won from the sale of its hardwood timber interests earlier this year.
But it added that as a result of the disposal of timber operations, the overall results were not comparable with the previous year.
HL&H's sugar interests delivered an improvement in performance, recording a slight 2.8 million rand loss compared to a 40.9 million rand loss previously.
